शायण्डायन m. pl. N. of a partic. association g. ऐषुकार्य्-आदि.
शायण्डायन—भक्त mfn. inhabited by the Śāyaṇḍāyanas, ib.

m: शायक mf(इका)n. id., Viṣṇ. (cf. कोश-, वृक्ष-शायिका)
a: शायकः — 1 An arrow. --2 A sword; cf. सायक.

m: शायन n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
शायस्थि m. N. of a teacher, VBr.
शाययितव्य mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be made to lie upon (loc.), Kād.
to be made to sleep (with दीर्घम्, ‘to be made to sleep the long or eternal sleep’ i.e. ‘to be put to death’), Bālar.
शायिका (इका), f. sleeping, lying (‘manner of lying’ or ‘one's turn to rest’), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 108, Vārtt. 1; ii, 2, 15, Sch.
शायिन् mfn. lying down, reclining, resting, abiding, Br. &c. &c. (mostly ifc.; cf. अधः-, एक-श्˚ &c.)
शायि-ता f. (fr. next) the state of lying or reposing or abiding in (ifc.), MBh.; Kathās.
शाय्यिक mfn. = शय्यया जीवति, g. वेतनादि.
